item.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
item.description: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers. (2 sources: infoq, javascriptweekly)

Spring Boot vs Quarkus on a 512 MB VPS with JDK 25
item.description: I ran equivalent Spring Boot 3.5 and Quarkus 3.39 applications side by side on the same 512 MB VPS. Both were JVM applications running on JDK 25 . Quarkus native image was not used. (1 source: rprogramming)
